verdict.rationale: Composio offers a catalog of 1000+ toolkits and lets agents search it. However, the evidence never shows published quality signals for comparing servers or toolkits, such as usage counts, health or liveness checks, quality scores, or verification badges. The only related item is a third-party provider (TypeSafe's Jev model) that attaches a confidence score to runtime tool selection. That is an adjacent feature, not a published quality signal, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compare servers using published quality signals — usage counts, health or liveness checks, scores, or verification badges
